## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Huáyán fǎjiè xuánjìng* 華嚴法界玄鏡 in 2 fascicles is [澄觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%BE%84%E8%A7%80) Chéngguān's elaborate treatise on the *Avataṃsaka*'s doctrine of the *dharma-realm* (法界 / *dharmadhātu*), drawing together the conceptual articulation of his master's master ([杜順](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9D%9C%E9%A0%86) Dùshùn's *[Fǎjiè guānmén](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Titles/%E6%B3%95%E7%95%8C%E8%A7%80%E9%96%80)* 法界觀門, preserved in [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86) Zōngmì's later commentary T1884) with his own mature philosophical articulation. The "*xuánjìng*" / "profound mirror" metaphor figures the dharma-realm as a mirror that perfectly reflects all phenomena while remaining itself unobstructed.

**Abstract**

The work is conventionally datable to [澄觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%BE%84%E8%A7%80) Chéngguān's mature period, c. 787 – 838 CE. The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The doctrinal substance — the articulation of the four levels of the *dharma-dhātu* (*shì fǎjiè* 事法界 / phenomenal realm; *lǐ fǎjiè* 理法界 / principial realm; *lǐ shì wú'ài fǎjiè* 理事無礙法界 / principle-and-phenomenon non-obstructed realm; *shì shì wú'ài fǎjiè* 事事無礙法界 / phenomenon-and-phenomenon non-obstructed realm) — is the metaphysical apex of mature Huáyán doctrine and was the basis for all subsequent East Asian Buddhist articulations of the *Avataṃsaka*'s ontology.

The Taishō text (T1883) is established on the standard apparatus.
